audit_target: Step61 toric-cone T^2-invariant warped drift model and its replacement by full Einstein-compatible 2-jets

step61_warped_ricci_audit.verdict: The mode is not Ricci-neutral or Einstein-compatible. At the Weyl degeneracy value eps*A=Lambda/16 it has O(Lambda) trace/traceless Ricci defect, so Step61 reachability is not reachability under ||Ric-Lambda g|| -> 0.

axis_smoothness_audit.verdict: No nonzero T^2-invariant homogeneous degree-2 harmonic can be both harmonic and smooth-axis compatible inside this toric ansatz. Angular cutoffs would add second angular derivatives to Dv.

full_quadratic_jet_curvature_space_audit.verdict: Algebraic 4D curvature decomposes as Ricci data (rank 10) plus a 10-dimensional Ricci-flat/Weyl kernel. Hence Einstein-compatible normal-coordinate 2-jets form an affine space, and its tangent changes (W+,W-) freely while preserving Ricci to first order.

research_conclusion: Step61's specific toric warped ansatz must not be used as a near-pinched realizability construction: its Weyl reachability imports O(1) Ricci defect and violates toric-axis smoothness.

The failure is not a failure of the exponential drift mechanism. In full normal-coordinate Einstein-compatible 2-jets, Ricci is fixed while the 10 Weyl degrees of freedom vary freely; these jets are smooth and Z2-even for A1.

The rate-limited flux theorem should therefore be stated as a sharp conditional obstruction with an exponential escape channel, plus a finite Gamma-invariant reachability refinement for non-A1 ADE types.
